name: ChildLeaves
description: The named child leaves the conversation.
note: Offered only while a child is in the conversation (the Hub's minor=1 gate). Handled by this module: each named child in the conversation leaves it; adults are never removed by it.

source.description: The children here who leave the conversation.

prompt:
The named child leaves the conversation. Use it when the player, or a parent or another adult here, sends the child away (to play, to go home, to leave the grown-ups alone) and the child goes, or when the child decides to run off. Name only children.

If it applies, begin your response with '{key}:'.
